features.name: duration_log_norm
features.description: Log-scaled call duration normalized for linear margin contribution. Longer calls correlate with engagement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth monotonic engagement signal for linear separation.

features.name: campaign_pressure_score
features.description: Inverse-scaled campaign contact count; high values indicate over-contact (fatigue).
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded continuous severity of repeated contacts useful for SVM margin.

features.name: not_previously_contacted
features.description: Binary indicator that client has never been contacted before (pdays==999 sentinel).
features.expected_model_benefit: Crisp linear separator between fresh and prior-contact clients.

features.name: prior_contact_recency
features.description: Recency strength of prior contact; higher when pdays is small. Zero when never contacted.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous recency signal complementing the binary indicator.

features.name: previous_contacts_norm
features.description: Normalized count of previous contacts before this campaign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded prior-engagement intensity for linear projection.

features.name: macro_stress_index
features.description: Weighted composite of macroeconomic stress: high emp.var.rate, high euribor3m, high nr.employed indicate tighter conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of correlated macro variables into a single SVM-friendly axis.

features.name: consumer_sentiment_score
features.description: Combined consumer price and confidence signal; standardized average.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized consumer index pair for linear margin.

features.name: age_centered_norm
features.description: Standardized age capturing life-stage deviation from mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered continuous age suitable for SVM linear weighting.

features.name: cellular_contact_flag
features.description: Indicator for cellular vs telephone contact channel.
features.expected_model_benefit: Channel signal often correlated with response rate.

features.name: duration_per_campaign
features.description: Average duration per campaign contact, log-scaled. Captures per-contact engagement quality.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio feature giving smooth per-contact engagement intensity.

features.name: client_receptivity_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of client receptivity based on demographic and credit profile (education level, no default, owning housing, no loan). Higher means more likely receptive to financial offers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite human-readable score combining stability indicators for linear margin.

features.name: campaign_timing_quality_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of how favorable the contact timing is, considering month, day_of_week, and prior poutcome success indicators. Higher means more favorable timing context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-formulaic timing context for linear projection.
